latestVersion.changelog:
Summary: This release introduces a new local crawler, majorly reorganizes documentation, and updates core functionality for improved usability and independence.

- Added custom Python crawler (crawler/search_crawler.py and SerpAPI version) for direct data collection, removing third-party search API dependencies.
- Updated allowed-tools to include shell, enabling controlled execution of the crawler.
- Major documentation overhaul: added multiple new guides (使用指南, 快速参考, 获取飞书Webhook指南, etc.), removed obsolete and redundant files.
- Enhanced safety: local-only data processing, explicit platform compliance, more controlled script execution.
- Improved configuration clarity and setup instructions in SKILL.md and related docs.
- Reports and monitoring logic remain focused on new-energy vehicle brands, now more easily adaptable and deployable.
